title: Orientation Graph Primitives v0.1
description: The graph shapes the four orientation artifacts share. Three of them are literally derived from each other — a question set is compiled from a propagation, a session embeds both, a ledger export embeds the session — so a node list that meant one thing here and another there would be a drift with no possible justification. Shapes only: each artifact declares its own key list locally, because the key list is what the structural gates read as their denominator and a list assembled through composition is one no gate can see.

nodeName.description: A variable name as the caller supplied it. Not held to the program identifier pattern: these arrive as data-frame column names, and whether such a name can also be a program predicate is `kernel_ast`'s question at the point it becomes a program, not this artifact's.

edge.description: A pair of nodes as a two-element array. Whether the order is meaningful is the FIELD's business, not the shape's: a directed edge reads tail-then-head, an undirected pair is sorted so the same pair always writes the same way. Each field that uses this says which it is.
